3D polygon regions on geo3D.

| | |
|---|---|
| Component id | `open.echarts.Polygons3DChart` |
| Palette | **Open Components / ECharts 3D** → **Polygons 3D Chart** |
| Default size | 700 × 500 |
| WebGL | Needs ECharts-GL, which the browser downloads from the gateway the first time a 3D / WebGL component is shown, and a browser with WebGL enabled. |

![Polygons 3D Chart as dropped from the palette](images/Polygons3DChart/default.png)

*Polygons 3D Chart as dropped from the palette.* It takes any ECharts option in its `option` prop; the palette entry only decides which sample option a new component starts with.

<details>
<summary>Option of a freshly dropped component</summary>

```json
{
  "title": {
    "text": "Polygons 3D",
    "subtext": "Supply GeoJSON in the maps prop, set geo3D.map to its name, then add polygons3D data",
    "left": "center"
  },
  "series": []
}
```

</details>

## Making your own

1. In the Designer, drag **Polygons 3D Chart** from the **Open Components / ECharts 3D** group of the Perspective component palette onto a view.
2. Edit the `option` prop in the Property Editor, or paste a complete option over it (right-click `option`, **Paste**). Any option from the [ECharts documentation](https://echarts.apache.org/en/option.html) works as long as it is plain JSON (no JavaScript functions).
3. Bind the parts of the option that hold data; see [Binding Data](Binding-Data).
